verdict.rationale: PostHog's product-analytics docs say you can save insights to dashboards and "set alerts on the numbers that matter" and "get alerted when they move." PostHog AI can create alerts, and the MCP OAuth metadata exposes alert:read/write scopes, so metric alerting is a first-party capability. The evidence does not show dashboard subscriptions (scheduled report delivery) or anomaly detection for abnormal movement, as opposed to simple movement or threshold alerts. Missing for 10: dashboard subscription/scheduled delivery, anomaly-detection alerting, in-depth alert configuration docs, independent or hands-on corroboration.
